question.text: An Indian AIF manager sets up a feeder fund in GIFT City (IFSC) to pool foreign investors into the domestic master. The feeder fund is registered as a Fund Management Entity (FME) under which regulations?

explanation.text: The Logic: A GIFT-IFSC feeder fund is registered as a Fund Management Entity (FME) under the IFSCA (Fund Management) Regulations, 2025. The Trap: Option A applies to the onshore Indian AIF (master), not the IFSC feeder. Option C (FPI) is the route foreign investors would use to invest into Indian securities directly, not the feeder itself. Option D is the FEMA currency-movement regime, not a fund-registration regime. Note: The workbook (p. 129) supports the FME registration of a GIFT-IFSC feeder under the IFSCA (Fund Management) Regulations, 2025.
